newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Stentor plans placing, expects 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Stentor plans placing, expects 1996 loss.

text.p: Irish-based telecommunications company Stentor Plc said on Friday it was planning an institutional placing to finance a network expansion, and its results for the 15 months to end-March were expected to show a pre-tax loss of 1.6 million stg.

"The directors of Stentor announce that plans are well advanced for an institutional placing to finance the expansion of the company's telecommunications network to cater for current and anticipated traffic and to provide working capital generally," Stentor said in a statement.
"The current expectation is that the placing will be priced in the region of the current share price."
It said full details of the placing would be sent to shareholders "as soon as practicable" along with the preliminary announcement of its results to end-March.
